deadlines.title: PAYE and National Insurance payment to HMRC (monthly)
deadlines.ruleText: Pay what you owe by the 22nd of the month (or the 19th if paying by post). The amount is the tax and National Insurance reported on your FPS in the previous tax month, minus any EPS reductions.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers paying HMRC monthly (other than by cheque through the post)
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Running payroll: Paying HMRC

deadlines.title: PAYE and National Insurance payment to HMRC by post (cheque)
deadlines.ruleText: If you pay by cheque through the post, it must reach HMRC by the 19th of the month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers paying HMRC by cheque through the post
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Pay employers' PAYE: Overview

deadlines.title: Employer Payment Summary (EPS) to claim reductions
deadlines.ruleText: In the next tax month (which starts on the 6th), you can claim any reduction on what you'll owe HMRC (for example statutory pay) by sending an Employer Payment Summary (EPS) by the 19th.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers claiming reductions such as statutory pay
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Running payroll: Reporting to HMRC: FPS

deadlines.title: Give employees a P60
deadlines.ruleText: Give your employees a P60 by 31 May (for the tax year ending 5 April).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers running payroll
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Payroll: annual reporting and tasks: Overview

deadlines.title: Report expenses and benefits to HMRC
deadlines.ruleText: You must report expenses and benefits to HMRC by 6 July.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers that provided taxable expenses and benefits
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Payroll: annual reporting and tasks: Report expenses and benefits

deadlines.title: Class 1A National Insurance payment on benefits
deadlines.ruleText: Your Class 1A National Insurance payment must be received by 22 July (or 19 July if you're paying by post).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers that provided taxable expenses and benefits
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Payroll: annual reporting and tasks: Report expenses and benefits

deadlines.title: Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung and payment of withheld wage tax (monthly filers)
deadlines.ruleText: The employer must file the Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung and pay the withheld wage tax to the Betriebsstättenfinanzamt no later than the tenth day after the end of each Lohnsteuer-Anmeldungszeitraum. The period is in principle the calendar month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers whose Lohnsteuer-Anmeldungszeitraum is the calendar month (the default)
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Gesetze im Internet - EStG § 41a Anmeldung und Abführung der Lohnsteuer

deadlines.title: Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung and payment (quarterly filers)
deadlines.ruleText: No later than the tenth day after the end of the calendar quarter (the period is the calendar quarter), if the wage tax to be remitted for the previous calendar year was more than 1,080 euros but not more than 5,000 euros.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers whose prior-year wage tax was over 1,080 and up to 5,000 euros
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Gesetze im Internet - EStG § 41a Anmeldung und Abführung der Lohnsteuer

deadlines.title: Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung and payment (annual filers)
deadlines.ruleText: No later than the tenth day after the end of the calendar year (the period is the calendar year), if the wage tax to be remitted for the previous calendar year was not more than 1,080 euros.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers whose prior-year wage tax was 1,080 euros or less
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Gesetze im Internet - EStG § 41a Anmeldung und Abführung der Lohnsteuer

deadlines.title: Electronic Lohnsteuerbescheinigung transmitted to tax authority
deadlines.ruleText: The electronic Lohnsteuerbescheinigung (§ 41b EStG) is transmitted per § 93c AO after the tax period, by the last day of February of the following year.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers closing the Lohnkonto for each employee
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Gesetze im Internet - AO § 93c Datenübermittlung durch Dritte

deadlines.title: Special annual report to statutory accident insurance (Jahresmeldung zur Unfallversicherung)
deadlines.ruleText: For each employee insured in accident insurance in a calendar year, the employer must submit a special annual report ("zum 16. Februar des Folgejahres", i.e. due 16 February of the following year).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with employees insured in statutory accident insurance
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Gesetze im Internet - SGB IV § 28a Meldepflicht

deadlines.title: DSN and payment of social contributions (employers under 50 employees)
deadlines.ruleText: Monthly DSN no later than the 15th of the month following the paid work period. Social contributions are due on the 15th of month M+1, whatever the salary payment date.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with fewer than 50 employees (average annual headcount at 31 December of the previous year)
deadlines.weekendNote: If the deadline falls on a public holiday or non-working day, it moves to the next working day. Stated for the DSN filing deadline; the payment table does not repeat it.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Service Public Entreprendre - Déclaration sociale nominative (DSN)

deadlines.title: DSN and payment of social contributions (50+ employees, pay in same month as work)
deadlines.ruleText: Monthly DSN no later than the 5th of the month following the paid work period. For salaries paid in month M, social contributions are due on the 5th of month M+1.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with 50 employees or more (payment table is headed "plus de 50") paying salary in the month worked
deadlines.weekendNote: If the deadline falls on a public holiday or non-working day, it moves to the next working day. Stated for the DSN filing deadline; the payment table does not repeat it.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Service Public Entreprendre - Déclaration sociale nominative (DSN)

deadlines.title: Payment of social contributions (50+ employees, salary paid the month after work)
deadlines.ruleText: For salaries paid in month M+1, social contributions are due on the 15th of month M+1.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with 50+ employees (table says "plus de 50") paying salary in the month after the work period
deadlines.weekendNote: If the deadline falls on a public holiday or non-working day, it moves to the next working day. Stated for the DSN filing deadline; the payment table does not repeat it.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Service Public Entreprendre - Déclaration sociale nominative (DSN)

deadlines.title: Quarterly payment of social contributions (option, under 11 employees)
deadlines.ruleText: Employers with fewer than 11 employees that opted for quarterly payment pay social contributions on the 15th of the first month of the following quarter.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with fewer than 11 employees that opted for quarterly payment
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Service Public Entreprendre - Déclaration sociale nominative (DSN)

deadlines.title: Loonaangifte and payment of loonheffingen (monthly period)
deadlines.ruleText: For monthly aangifte loonheffingen the latest filing and payment date is the last day of the month after the period (period January 2026: 28-02-2026; December 2026: 31-01-2027).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers whose aangiftetijdvak is a calendar month
deadlines.weekendNote: If the date is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, payment must arrive before that date.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Belastingdienst - Aangifte loonheffingen 2026: tijdvakcodes, aangifte- en betaaldatums

deadlines.title: Loonaangifte and payment of loonheffingen (annual period)
deadlines.ruleText: For the annual period (tijdvakcode 6400) the latest filing and payment date is 31 January of the following year (31-01-2027 for 2026).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with a year as aangiftetijdvak
deadlines.weekendNote: If the date is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, payment must arrive before that date.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Belastingdienst - Aangifte loonheffingen 2026: tijdvakcodes, aangifte- en betaaldatums

deadlines.title: Modelo 111 quarterly withholding return and payment (IRPF on employment income)
deadlines.ruleText: Quarterly self-assessment during the first twenty natural days of April, July, October and January, for withholdings of the immediately preceding natural quarter.
deadlines.appliesTo: Withholding agents filing Modelo 111 quarterly (not Grandes empresas or large public administrations)
deadlines.weekendNote: A deadline that falls on a Saturday or non-working day moves to the next working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Agencia Tributaria - Modelo 111 Instrucciones

deadlines.title: Modelo 111 monthly withholding return and payment (large companies)
deadlines.ruleText: Monthly self-assessment during the first twenty natural days of the month following the monthly self-assessment period (Grandes empresas and public administrations with annual budget over 6 million euros).
deadlines.appliesTo: Grandes empresas and public administrations with annual budget over 6 million euros
deadlines.weekendNote: A deadline that falls on a Saturday or non-working day moves to the next working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Agencia Tributaria - Modelo 111 Instrucciones

deadlines.title: Modelo 190 annual summary of withholdings (IRPF on employment income)
deadlines.ruleText: You must file Modelo 190 if you filed Modelo 111. The period is, in general, between 1 January and 31 January of the year following the one the annual return covers.
deadlines.appliesTo: Withholding agents that filed Modelo 111
deadlines.weekendNote: If the deadline falls on a non-working day, it ends on the next working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Agencia Tributaria - Retenciones e ingresos a cuenta - Obligaciones como retenedor

deadlines.title: Social security contributions payment (Seguridad Social cuotas)
deadlines.ruleText: Social security contributions are paid within the month following the one in which they accrue, unless the rules of a specific scheme set another period (for example self-employed: within the same month).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers in the general scheme (other schemes may set another period)
deadlines.weekendNote: If the last day is a non-working day, the deadline ends on the previous working day (RD 1415/2004, art. 8(b)).
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: BOE - Real Decreto 1415/2004, Reglamento General de Recaudación de la Seguridad Social (art. 56)

deadlines.title: Payment of withholding tax on employee income (F24)
deadlines.ruleText: Withholding agents (sostituti d'imposta) must pay the withholdings by the 16th day of the month following the month of payment, using Form F24.
deadlines.appliesTo: Sostituti d'imposta withholding tax on employee income
deadlines.weekendNote: Payment is on time if made on the first working day after a deadline that falls on a Saturday or public holiday.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Agenzia delle Entrate - F24 Ritenute reddito lavoro dipendente - Come e quando si versa

deadlines.title: Payment of INPS social security contributions
deadlines.ruleText: Employers pay social security and welfare contributions by the 16th of the month following the month in which the employee performed the work.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers of dependent workers
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: INPS - Pagamento dei contributi previdenziali

deadlines.title: UniEmens monthly return to INPS
deadlines.ruleText: For employers, the UniEmens flow must be sent by the last day of the month following the reference month. If the last day is a holiday, the deadline moves to the first working day of the following month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers of private companies (employers that used deferred DM10 terms keep their deferred term)
deadlines.weekendNote: If the last day is a public holiday, the deadline moves to the first working day of the following month.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: INPS - Trasmissione UNIEMENS per datori di lavoro di aziende private

deadlines.title: Certificazione Unica: give to payee and transmit to Agenzia delle Entrate
deadlines.ruleText: Certificazioni Uniche for employment income, self-employment not habitually exercised and miscellaneous income are transmitted online to the Agenzia delle Entrate by 16 March, and given to the payee by 16 March.
deadlines.appliesTo: Sostituti d'imposta issuing Certificazioni Uniche for employment income
deadlines.weekendNote: Deadlines that fall on a Saturday or public holiday move to the next working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Agenzia delle Entrate - Certificazione Unica 2026: istruzioni per la compilazione

deadlines.title: Modello 770 annual withholding agent return
deadlines.ruleText: The Mod. 770 is filed electronically by 31 October (art. 4, paragraph 4-bis, DPR 322/1998). Terms falling on a Saturday or holiday move to the first working day after.
deadlines.appliesTo: Sostituti d'imposta
deadlines.weekendNote: Deadlines that fall on a Saturday or public holiday move to the next working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Agenzia delle Entrate - Modello 770/2026: istruzioni

deadlines.title: Payroll taxes: Lohnsteuer, Dienstgeberbeitrag and DB surcharge payment
deadlines.ruleText: Wage-related levies (Lohnsteuer, Dienstgeberbeitrag, Zuschlag zum Dienstgeberbeitrag) are due on the 15th of the following month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers in Austria
deadlines.weekendNote: Taxes due on a Saturday, Sunday, public holiday, Good Friday or 24 December are payable on the next working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: BMF - Fristen und Fälligkeiten

deadlines.title: Kommunalsteuer (municipal payroll tax) payment
deadlines.ruleText: Kommunalsteuer is among the wage-related levies that are due on the 15th of the following month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers in Austria
deadlines.weekendNote: Taxes due on a Saturday, Sunday, public holiday, Good Friday or 24 December are payable on the next working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: BMF - Fristen und Fälligkeiten

deadlines.title: Monthly contribution base report (mBGM) to health insurance fund
deadlines.ruleText: In the self-assessment procedure the mBGM is submitted by the 15th after the end of each contribution period. If employment starts after the 15th, the deadline is the 15th of the month after next.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers in the self-assessment procedure (Selbstabrechner)
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: ÖGK - Meldefristen

deadlines.title: Social insurance contributions payment (ÖGK)
deadlines.ruleText: General contributions fall due on the last day of the calendar month in which the contribution period ends. They count as paid on time if credited within 15 days after that due date, which means by the 15th of the following month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers paying contributions to the health insurance fund
deadlines.weekendNote: If the last day of the 15-day period falls on a Saturday, Sunday, public holiday, Good Friday or 24 December, the period extends to the next bank working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: ÖGK - Zahlungsfrist

deadlines.title: Annual wage statements (Lohnzettel) to the tax office
deadlines.ruleText: After the calendar year the employer must send the Lohnzettel for each employee electronically via ELDA, in principle by the end of February of the following year.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers in Austria
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: BMF - Fristen und Fälligkeiten

deadlines.title: ONSS/RSZ social security contributions payment (quarterly)
deadlines.ruleText: The employer pays contributions quarterly. They must reach the ONSS at the latest on the last day of the month following the quarter: 30 April, 31 July, 31 October and 31 January.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers registered with the ONSS/RSZ
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Sécurité sociale (ONSS) - Instructions administratives: Règle générale de paiement

deadlines.title: DmfA quarterly social security declaration
deadlines.ruleText: The employer (or its mandatary) files the DmfA with the ONSS in the month following the quarter: by 30 April, 31 July, 31 October and 31 January.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers registered with the ONSS/RSZ
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Sécurité sociale (ONSS) - Instructions administratives: DmfA, généralités

deadlines.title: Withheld income tax advances on employment income (monthly remittance)
deadlines.ruleText: The monthly remittance of the total advances withheld on employment income for a month is due on the 20th of the following month. The tax calendar lists a later date when the 20th falls on a weekend (for example 22 June and 21 September 2026).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers withholding income tax advances
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Finanční správa - Daňový kalendář

deadlines.title: Social security contributions and monthly report to ČSSZ
deadlines.ruleText: Employer contributions for a calendar month are payable from the 1st to the 20th day of the following calendar month. Within the same period the employer submits the unified monthly report (jednotné měsíční hlášení) with the assessment base and contribution amount to the CSSZ.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: ČSSZ - Platba a termíny

deadlines.title: Health insurance contributions for employees (VZP)
deadlines.ruleText: Employee health insurance contributions are paid for each calendar month and are payable from the 1st to the 20th day of the following calendar month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers
deadlines.weekendNote: If the last day of the payment period falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the last day is the nearest following working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: VZP - Splatnost pojistného

deadlines.title: Statement of health insurance payments (Přehled o platbách pojistného)
deadlines.ruleText: Employers send each health insurer a statement of insurance payments for their insured employees no later than the 20th day of the following month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: VZP - Povinnost podat přehled o platbě pojistného

deadlines.title: PAYE, PRSI and USC payment to Revenue (monthly remitters)
deadlines.ruleText: Monthly remitters pay the total liability within 14 days after the end of each month. The employer accepts the monthly statement by the 14th of the following month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers remitting monthly who do not use the ROS extension
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Revenue - Paying your employees' tax to Revenue

deadlines.title: PAYE, PRSI and USC payment to Revenue (monthly, ROS extension)
deadlines.ruleText: The payment deadline extends to 23 days after the end of the month if the employer files the return and pays the tax on the Revenue Online Service (ROS).
deadlines.appliesTo: Monthly remitters who file and pay through ROS
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Revenue - Paying your employees' tax to Revenue

deadlines.title: PAYE, PRSI and USC payment to Revenue (quarterly remitters)
deadlines.ruleText: Quarterly remitters pay by 14 April, 14 July, 14 October and 14 January (23rd of the same months with the ROS extension). Quarterly remitting is for employers with yearly payments of EUR 28,800 or less who apply.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers approved to remit quarterly (yearly PAYE, PRSI and USC of EUR 28,800 or less)
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Revenue - Paying your employees' tax to Revenue

deadlines.title: Employee PIT advance (zaliczka) payment to the tax office (monthly)
deadlines.ruleText: The employer pays the PIT advance withheld from salaries by the 20th day of the month following the month in which the salary was paid.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers withholding PIT on salaries
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: biznes.gov.pl - Jak rozliczać PIT pracownika

deadlines.title: ZUS contributions and DRA declaration - payers with legal personality
deadlines.ruleText: The ZUS DRA declaration and monthly reports are submitted and contributions paid by the 15th day of the following month by payers with legal personality (for example limited companies).
deadlines.appliesTo: Payers with legal personality (e.g. sp. z o.o., S.A., foundations)
deadlines.weekendNote: If the end of the deadline falls on a public holiday, Saturday or Sunday, the next working day counts as the last day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: ZUS - Termin składania dokumentów i opłacania składek

deadlines.title: ZUS contributions and DRA declaration - other payers
deadlines.ruleText: The ZUS DRA declaration and monthly reports are submitted and contributions paid by the 20th day of the following month by other payers, such as sole traders and partnerships without legal personality that employ staff.
deadlines.appliesTo: Payers without legal personality that employ staff (e.g. sole traders, partnerships)
deadlines.weekendNote: If the end of the deadline falls on a public holiday, Saturday or Sunday, the next working day counts as the last day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: ZUS - Termin składania dokumentów i opłacania składek

deadlines.title: PIT-11 annual income information to the tax office
deadlines.ruleText: PIT-11 and PIT-R are sent to the tax office by the end of January of the year following the tax year (and PIT-11 to the taxpayer by the end of February).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers and other payers of employment income
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: podatki.gov.pl - Serwis o podatkach: płatnik

deadlines.title: PIT-4R annual return of withheld advances
deadlines.ruleText: PIT-4R is prepared and sent only to the tax office by the end of January of the year following the tax year.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers and other payers withholding PIT advances
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: podatki.gov.pl - Serwis o podatkach: płatnik

deadlines.title: Declaration 112 and payment of salary income tax and social contributions (monthly)
deadlines.ruleText: Employers file Form 112 monthly. The ANAF tax calendar sets the 25th of the following month, moved to the next working day when it falls on a weekend (for example 26 January and 27 April 2026). Payment is due by the same date as the declaration.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers and equivalent payers of salary income
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: ANAF - Calendarul obligațiilor fiscale

deadlines.title: Employer declaration (arbetsgivardeklaration) - turnover over SEK 40 million
deadlines.ruleText: For employers with turnover above SEK 40 million the declaration is normally due on the 26th of the month after pay-out, moved to the next working day on a weekend (for example 27 April 2026). Payment is due earlier, by the 12th (17th in January).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with turnover over SEK 40 million per income year
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteverket - När ska jag lämna arbetsgivardeklaration?

deadlines.title: IRS withholding on employment income: payment to the tax authority
deadlines.ruleText: Amounts withheld on employment income (IRS) must be paid over by the 20th of the month following the one in which they were deducted.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers withholding IRS on employment income
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira - Código do IRS, artigo 98.º

deadlines.title: Monthly remuneration declaration (DMR) to the tax authority
deadlines.ruleText: Employers file the official declaration of income paid, tax withheld, mandatory social-protection contributions and union dues by the 10th of the month following payment, for employment income.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers paying employment income
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira - Código do IRS, artigo 119.º

deadlines.title: Annual statement of pay and tax withheld to each employee
deadlines.ruleText: By 20 January each year, give the taxpayer a document showing the amounts due in the previous year, including income in kind, tax withheld and any deductions.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers and other payers of income subject to IRS
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira - Código do IRS, artigo 119.º

deadlines.title: Social security contributions payment (employers)
deadlines.ruleText: Contributions are paid monthly, based on data made available by social security, between day 1 and day 25 of the month after the one they relate to. New model phased in during 2026; mandatory for all employers from 1 Jan 2027.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers declaring remuneration to Portuguese social security
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Diário da República - Decreto-Lei n.º 127/2025, de 9 de dezembro (new art. 43.º, Código Contributivo)

deadlines.title: A-melding (monthly payroll report to the Norwegian authorities)
deadlines.ruleText: The deadline to submit the a-melding is the 5th of every month, for the previous month. It reports salary, other income and advance tax deductions.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers reporting salary and other income
deadlines.weekendNote: If the 5th falls on a weekend or a holiday, the deadline is on the first following working day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteetaten - The a-melding: Deadlines and payment

deadlines.title: Annual summary of income and tax deductions to employees
deadlines.ruleText: Every year by 1 February, employers must submit an annual summary of incomes, deductions and withholding tax for their employees (for the previous income year).
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with employees
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteetaten - The a-melding: Summary to the employee

deadlines.title: Employer's separate report to the Incomes Register
deadlines.ruleText: File the employer's separate report on health insurance contributions once a month, by the fifth day of the calendar month following the payday month. Registered employers file it also for months without wages.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers paying wages (registered employers also for months with no wages)
deadlines.weekendNote: If the deadline falls on a Saturday, Sunday or other holiday, the data can be reported on the following business day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Verohallinto - How to report wages and employer's contributions

deadlines.title: Employer's contributions: monthly return and payment due date
deadlines.ruleText: With a monthly tax period, employer's contributions are filed and paid by the 12th of the following month (e.g. the March return is due 12 April). Quarterly or extended periods follow a different cycle.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with a monthly tax period for employer's contributions
deadlines.weekendNote: If the 12th falls on a Saturday, Sunday or a public holiday, the date is extended to the next business day.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: Verohallinto - Filing and paying VAT and other self-assessed taxes: detailed guidance

deadlines.title: Personal income tax advances withheld from employees: declaration and payment
deadlines.ruleText: The employer declares and pays the income tax advance withheld by the 12th of the month following the accounted month (NAV: 'hónap 12-éig' - up to and including the 12th).
deadlines.appliesTo: Hungarian employers withholding personal income tax advances
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: NAV - Bevallási, adófizetési információk (information booklet no. 24, published 26 Jan 2026)

deadlines.title: Social contribution tax: monthly declaration and payment
deadlines.ruleText: The payer assesses social contribution tax monthly and declares and pays it by the 12th of the month following the reference month (NAV: 'hónap 12-ig' - up to and including the 12th).
deadlines.appliesTo: Payers of social contribution tax (employers)
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: NAV - Bevallási, adófizetési információk (information booklet no. 24, published 26 Jan 2026)

deadlines.title: AHV/IV/EO contributions: quarterly payment (payroll up to CHF 200,000)
deadlines.ruleText: Employers with an annual payroll up to CHF 200,000 pay contributions quarterly. The latest payment date is always the 10th day after the end of the quarter, e.g. contributions for the first quarter by 10 April.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with an annual payroll up to CHF 200,000
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: AHV-IV.ch (Bundesamt für Sozialversicherungen) - Merkblatt 2.01 Lohnbeiträge an die AHV, die IV und die EO

deadlines.title: AHV/IV/EO contributions: monthly payment (payroll over CHF 200,000)
deadlines.ruleText: Employers with an annual payroll above CHF 200,000 pay contributions monthly. The latest payment date is always the 10th day after the end of the month.
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers with an annual payroll above CHF 200,000
deadlines.sourceLabel: Source: AHV-IV.ch (Bundesamt für Sozialversicherungen) - Merkblatt 2.01 Lohnbeiträge an die AHV, die IV und die EO
